title: Visual Contextual Attack: Jailbreaking MLLMs with Image-Driven Context Injection
abstract: arXiv:2507.02844v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: With the emergence of strong vision language capabilities, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated tremendous potential for real-world applications. However, the security vulnerabilities exhibited by the visual modality pose significant challenges to deploying such models in open-world environments. Recent studies have successfully induced harmful responses from target MLLMs by encoding harmful textual semantics directly into visual inputs. However, in these approaches, the visual modality primarily serves as a trigger for unsafe behavior, often exhibiting semantic ambiguity and lacking grounding in realistic scenarios. translated_title: 视觉上下文攻击：利用图像驱动的上下文注入越狱多模态大语言模型
translated_abstract: 随着强大的视觉语言能力的出现，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在现实世界应用中展现出巨大的潜力。然而，视觉模态所表现出的安全漏洞对在开放世界环境中部署此类模型构成了重大挑战。近期的研究通过将有害文本语义直接编码到视觉输入中，成功诱导目标MLLMs产生有害响应。然而，在这些方法中，视觉模态主要充当不安全行为的触发器，往往表现出语义模糊性，并且缺乏与现实场景的关联。在这项工作中，我们定义了一个新颖的设置：以视觉为中心的越狱，其中视觉信息作为构建完整且真实的越狱上下文的必要组成部分。基于这一设置，我们提出了VisCo（视觉上下文）攻击。VisCo伪造上下文对话（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新颖的“以视觉为中心的越狱”设定及VisCo攻击方法，通过图像驱动的上下文注入构建完整真实的越狱语境，从而有效攻击多模态大语言模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel vision-centric jailbreak setting and the VisCo Attack, which leverages image-driven context injection to construct complete and realistic jailbreak contexts, effectively attacking multimodal large language models.
